HOW TO PLAY

Add music, press the beat.

  1. Pick an audio file to analyze its waveform and hits.
  2. Choose a difficulty and note speed, then start playing.
  3. Press ← · ↑ · ↓ · → when a note reaches the line (switch to WASD in settings). On mobile, tap the four buttons below.
  4. SPACE / ESC to pause. If timing feels off, pause and adjust the offset.

Analysis runs entirely on your device. Files are never saved or uploaded, and you'll need to choose again after a refresh. Any audio format your browser can decode is supported.

This version is a single-note auto-charting prototype. The estimated BPM is a reference value based on a fixed tempo.

NEXT LEVEL / REFERENCES

Where could this go next?

01 osu!mania ↗

The top reference for vertical, key-based play. Next: long notes, a pattern editor, finer judgment tuning.

02 Audiosurf 2 ↗

A direction built around the player's own music. Next: backgrounds that react to intensity, section-by-section pattern changes.

03 DJMAX RESPECT V ↗

A reference for a polished music-arcade experience. Next: hit effects, a results screen, a richer track-select flow.

Suggested combo: osu!mania-style 4-key input + Audiosurf-style auto-generation from your own music. The above are ideas for future expansion.
